thinking: The click_and_read returned a toast-like element at the end of the page: 'Starred thread / Project Update — Q1 Milestones'. That is exactly the kind of optimistic success message the user request says not to trust. Meanwhile the star button in the readback controls is still labelled 'Star Project Update — Q1 Milestones', not 'Unstar ...', and article [26] still carries the same label. So the evidence is contradictory and does not confirm the star was applied. The correct next move is a full page reload to get an independent, freshly rendered visible state. A reload is read-only and cannot double-toggle the star, so it is safe even if the first click did take effect.
